name: Gheorghe Falcă - § 27 - Am 27
title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2023
part_text: 27. Following the fact-finding visit to Romania, stresses the need for full and consistent implementation of the Habitats Directive1a to improve the protection of valuable natural areas and wildlife as well as citizens’ well-being; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Council Directive 92/43/EEC of 21 May 1992 on the conservation of natural habitats and of wild fauna and flora, OJ L 206, 22.7.1992, p. 7, ELI: [http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/1992/43/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/1992/43/oj).
